name: Sample 2 (High Real Confidence)
title: House Republicans to meet with Trump on Thursday: aide
text: House Republicans to meet with Trump on Thursday: aide WASHINGTON (Reuters) - House of Representatives Republican leaders and members of the Ways and Means Committee will meet with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday at the White House, a Republican aide said. The meeting will take place at around 1:30 p.m. (1730 GMT), the aide told Reuters on Wednesday. Congressional Republicans are expected to unveil tax reform legislation this week.
